title: Stasis Egghead Surreal
description: A blue-skinned female figure with an egg-shaped head topped with fruit kneels on a checkered patio holding a retro lamp. She wears a blue top, denim shorts, and high heels, surrounded by floating transparent spheres containing food and lights, with a vintage orange car and a striped gothic building labeled STASIS in the background.
prompt: A surreal scene featuring a blue-skinned woman with an egg for a head, cracked open and spilling fruit, kneeling on a patterned patio in front of a black and white striped gothic building with a neon STASIS sign. She wears a blue cutout top, denim shorts with bows, and blue heels, holding an ornate retro floor lamp. A vintage orange 1960s car is parked to the left, while transparent floating spheres contain sandwiches and glowing lights. Bright daylight, highly detailed, realistic rendering with pop surrealist style.
